handoff.salientSummary: Completed the Setup backend routes and services (/operator/reservations/setup/*) and the staged Step 0 foundation items (VAL-FND-006, VAL-FND-009, VAL-FND-024, reflowDay, and KSA 0016 trigger refresh). Verified 19 test files (71 tests) in @repo/reservations, 13 test files (177 tests) in @repo/tenant-db, 7 integration tests in reservations-setup.test.ts, and 14 security sweep tests in reservations-security.test.ts.
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
1. Completed and verified the staged Step 0 foundation items in @repo/reservations (enforcing online_cap_per_interval, concurrent_covers_cap, rolling_min/rolling_max_covers, per-table reset_buffer_min, counting overbook rows in OccupancyIndex and the oracle, returning { sameDay, otherDates } from alternatives(), passing Math.min(MAX_BOOK_EXPANSIONS, remainingBudget) in reflowDay without partial move plans, and verifying canonical invariants I1-I8 in packages/reservations/src/testing/*), ADR 048 (all 12 contract sections in docs/decisions/048-reservations-data-residency.md), and refreshReservationsTriggers in packages/tenant-db/src/migrations.ts and apps/tenant-api/scripts/seed-reservations.ts.
2. Fixed all TypeScript import and engine call-site issues in apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-setup-service.ts and implemented apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-setup-crud.ts for dining areas, tables (unique active label per location, archive unassignment and future soft-booking reflow), table combinations (combinable and canonical duplicate member-set checks), floor elements, atomic floor-plan save (with expectedFloorPlanVersion / floorPlanVersion 409 stale_version conflict check and shrink/archive reflow), services & weekly templates, turn-time buckets, pacing rules, per-service table/area availability modes (XOR target), special days, and table/area blocks (expanding into rsv_table_occupancies and reflowing soft future bookings).
3. Wired all /operator/reservations/setup/* endpoints in apps/tenant-api/src/routes/operator-reservations-setup.ts (and re-exported in apps/tenant-api/src/routes/reservations-setup.ts) and mounted them at /setup in apps/tenant-api/src/routes/reservations-operator.ts with rsvGuard('setup', ...), read/update permission enforcement, location scope isolation, and non-echoing Zod validation error formatting.
4. Seeded both US (acme) and KSA (riyadh-grill) local tenant DBs and verified all 9 0016 triggers in sqlite_master.
5. Added apps/tenant-api/src/routes/reservations-setup.test.ts (7 comprehensive integration tests) and expanded apps/tenant-api/src/routes/reservations-security.test.ts (14 security sweep tests covering every mounted setup endpoint plus explicit VAL-SETUP-027 and VAL-SETUP-028 assertions).
